About this model

Graphics planned around the Dacia Dokker.

Every Dacia Dokker variant has its own door gaps, handles, swage lines and glazing, so we lay your graphics out on the matching template rather than a generic van shape. Tell us about roof racks, ladders or bodywork changes and we will allow for them.

Fitting tip

Send a photo of each side and the back with your order, so we can check the template against your actual van before anything is printed.

What each option includes

Simple graphics
Your name, logo, services and contact details with stripes or shapes in one, two or full colour, laid out on the Dacia Dokker template. Fixed price by variant.
Half wrap
Printed colour over the rear half, lower sides or a sweep, with lettering on the paint. Quoted once we know the coverage. About partial wraps
Full wrap
Printed imagery or a colour change across almost every painted panel. Quoted per van. About full wraps

Vehicle damaged?

We can organise panel repairs.

Graphics look their best on straight, sound panels, and vinyl cannot hide dents or rust. If your Dacia Dokker needs some bodywork first, we can organise panel repairs as part of the service, so it comes back repaired and branded in one go.

  • Dents, scrapes and scuffed panels
  • Rust spots and chipped paint
  • Damaged bumpers and trims
Ask for details and a quote Send photos of the damage with your enquiry and we will include the repair in your quote.

Before you book

Good to know.

How do I choose the right Dacia Dokker variant?

Pick the year and body style that match your van. If you are not sure, send the registration with your enquiry and we will check it.

Are the graphics prices fitted?

The graphics price covers the designed vinyl graphics for your variant. Fitting at our Norwich workshop is added to your written quote.

Can I get a half or full wrap on my Dacia Dokker?

Yes. Choose half wrap or full wrap and send your details; wraps are quoted per van once we know the coverage and artwork.

Get a free quote

What are you driving?

Tell us the make and model, how many vehicles you have and the look you’re after. If you have photos or artwork, have them handy.
